name: Sly Kingdom
summary: Sly Kingdom is an online fantasy RPG for Android and PC that combines an open world with competitive PvP arenas. Players choose one of six classes (archer, assassin, warrior, shield, mage and pikeman), level up to 50 through quests and hunting, and then unlock a specialization tree with three paths per class. The world includes creature hunting and capture with a bestiary, professions, guilds, caravans and territory conquest. PvP modes include ranked 1v1, 3v3 and 5v5 arenas, a coliseum and an ARAM mode. Characters progress through talents, specializations, equipment forging and cosmetic affinity rewards.
